changeSet.author: kmcnamee
changeSet.sql: create or alter VIEW [utility].[ArtifactAssetParent] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS select aim.AssetID, aim.ParentArtifactID, IA.ID as ParentAssetID from [utility].[ArtifactAssetParentIntermediate] aim with (NOEXPAND) inner join dbo.Asset IA on trim(IA.Object +' ')= 'Artifact' and aim.ParentArtifactID = IA.ObjectID
changeSet.rollback: create or alter VIEW [utility].[ArtifactAssetParent] WITH SCHEMABINDING AS select aim.AssetID, aim.ParentArtifactID, IA.ID as ParentAssetID from [utility].[ArtifactAssetParentIntermediate] aim inner join dbo.Asset IA on IA.Object= 'Artifact' and aim.ParentArtifactID = IA.ObjectID
